listing.name: BotBound
listing.description: BotBound lets a new Claude user create a BotBound account, build their first Bot in that conversation, privately rehearse it, and inspect privacy-minimized workspace status. Phone numbers, live calls, messaging, billing, and launch stay in BotBound.

use_cases: Create a BotBound account and a confirmed first Bot draft from a conversation.
Refine a saved draft's tone, prohibited topics, and handoff policy.
Inspect aggregate workspace status without exposing customer content.
Run a short private, tool-free voice simulation of a saved draft.
Privately rehearse a hypothetical customer line without placing a live call.
Read owner-authored Training and, after the Apps toggle, save a confirmed fact or rule.
prerequisites: New users create a BotBound account during OAuth. Existing users sign in.
OAuth consent for agents.read, agents.write, and demo.voice.

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Use BotBound to create an after-hours receptionist for my HVAC company. It should ask for ZIP code and urgency, never quote prices, and offer an estimate callback.
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Inline agent-draft card after confirmed creation

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Update my BotBound draft so it stays warm, never quotes a price, avoids medical advice, and only hands off when a BotBound handoff path is configured.
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Updated draft card with refined boundaries

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Give me a BotBound workspace summary: how many agents and assigned numbers do I have, what activity occurred in the last 30 days, and are text and email connected?
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Workspace summary card with aggregate counts only

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Let me privately try the voice simulation for this BotBound draft.
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Private voice controls on the draft card

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Privately rehearse this BotBound agent answering: Do you have Saturday appointments?
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Private rehearsal reply with live_call false

reviewer_prompts.prompt: Show me the coaching brief for this BotBound agent, then save a confirmed Training fact if Apps writes are on.
reviewer_prompts.screenshot_subject: Coaching brief and fail-closed Training write guidance

negative_prompts: Write a cold email for my plumbing company.
Use my BotBound agent to call the lead, book the appointment, and text them a confirmation now.
Make whatever changes you think are best to my BotBound agent.
